subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DM replies fall back after stale DM-scope cleanup in 2026.7.2-beta.3

question: Should the message tool receive a separately named live run-session key for source-reply receipt and transcript/session routing while retaining the sandbox session key for tool capability and authorization decisions?
rationale: The source reproduction shows the receipt lookup needs the live key, but the same comment correctly identifies that the sandbox key may be intentional for runtime policy. Choosing a single replacement key without confirming that boundary could alter authorization behavior beyond the bug fix.

options.title: Separate receipt routing from policy identity
options.body: Thread runSessionKey into the message tool and use it only for terminal source-reply receipt and related live-session routing; preserve agentSessionKey for policy and sandbox decisions.

options.title: Use the live key everywhere
options.body: Replace the message tool’s sandbox key entirely, accepting broader policy-identity changes that require explicit security and ownership review.

options.title: Keep current binding
options.body: Retain the current sandbox-only binding and accept continued recovery-ownership failures for split-session Codex turns.

recommendation.title: Separate receipt routing from policy identity
recommendation.body: Thread runSessionKey into the message tool and use it only for terminal source-reply receipt and related live-session routing; preserve agentSessionKey for policy and sandbox decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: Their source-level reproduction identifies both the causal lookup and the exact policy-boundary question that needs confirmation.
